summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by AFS SenSub Corp. as depositor and GM Financial as sponsor for the issuance of asset-backed notes by GM Financial Consumer Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-3. The filing reports the entry into a material definitive agreement for a securitization transaction involving $190M Class A-1 3.904% notes, $295.61M Class A-2-A 4.28% notes, $62M floating rate notes, $357.61M Class A-3 4.44% notes, $78.19M Class A-4 4.56% notes, $16.71M Class B 4.70% notes, $15.67M Class C 4.89% notes, and an asset-backed certificate. The notes are backed by prime auto loan receivables. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring are present.
